answer.exemplar: A cantilever is stable only when the moments about the pier balance. The loading arm projects a long way from the pier and so its load tries to overturn the whole structure, while nothing on the other side resists that pull. questions.explanation: A cantilever has nothing on its short side to resist the overturning moment of the load on its long side. The counterweight provides the balancing moment so the pier can hold the whole assembly in equilibrium.
